title: Release-grade IO FAT, fast workspace switching, and one-click process-bus capture
titleId: IO FAT siap rilis, perpindahan workspace cepat, dan capture process bus sekali klik
summary: ARSAS 1.6.19 delivers a release-grade IEC 61850 IO List FAT workflow with Rev.3 event-log traceability, executive evidence reporting, persistent Engineering/FAT workspace switching, and one-click receive-only GOOSE and bounded SMV entry from each IED card.
summaryId: ARSAS 1.6.19 menghadirkan workflow FAT IO List IEC 61850 yang siap rilis dengan traceability event log Rev.3, report evidence eksekutif, perpindahan workspace Engineering/FAT yang tetap loaded, serta akses GOOSE receive-only dan SMV bounded sekali klik dari setiap IED card.
highlights: Rev.3 FAT_Points_Import and Document_Control workbooks preserve the exact IEC 61850 event-log search reference, source state semantics, report display reference, document metadata and review reason without inventing missing telegrams.

The native executive FAT PDF now presents AS TESTED document control, document number and revision, exact IEC 61850 reference, expected state, ON/OFF relay timestamps, result summary, test basis and sign-off areas.
A loaded IO List FAT project remains in memory while the user moves to Engineering and back; another workbook or .arsas project is loaded only through an explicit replacement action.
GOOSE can be opened directly from the selected IED card, with routed Windows NIC to Npcap resolution and automatic receive-only capture when one adapter is proven.
SMV can be opened directly from an IED card, select the first discovered stream, capture a bounded two-cycle snapshot and render raw values plus waveform evidence.
highlightsId: Workbook Rev.3 FAT_Points_Import dan Document_Control mempertahankan exact IEC 61850 event-log search reference, source state semantics, report display reference, metadata dokumen dan review reason tanpa membuat telegram yang hilang.

PDF FAT eksekutif native kini menampilkan document control AS TESTED, document number dan revision, exact IEC 61850 reference, expected state, timestamp relay ON/OFF, result summary, test basis dan area sign-off.
Project IO List FAT yang sudah loaded tetap berada di memori saat user pindah ke Engineering lalu kembali; workbook atau project .arsas lain hanya dibuka melalui tindakan replacement yang eksplisit.
GOOSE dapat dibuka langsung dari IED card terpilih, dengan pemetaan routed Windows NIC ke Npcap dan capture receive-only otomatis saat satu adapter terbukti.
SMV dapat dibuka langsung dari IED card, memilih stream pertama hasil discovery, capture snapshot bounded dua siklus, lalu menampilkan raw value dan waveform evidence.
improvements: IO FAT preparation cards use smoothed determinate progress derived from real connection, discovery, binding and acquisition readiness instead of an infinite animation.
Known Application display wrappers are normalized during live signal matching while exact source and event-log references remain preserved for reporting and diagnostics.
Completed evidence rows are excluded before preflight, live preparation and session start, allowing pending rows to continue without erasing or re-requesting completed evidence.
Window lifecycle guards prevent Engineering from being shown again during application shutdown while retaining instant hide/show behavior during normal workspace switching.
The FAT report uses a calmer document-style hierarchy, neutral document control, inline device results, smaller title typography and a modern font fallback stack.
Release gates cover the full application build, IO FAT regression suite, deterministic SV evidence tests, portable packaging, installer smoke tests, checksums, SPDX SBOM and provenance.
improvementsId: Card preparation IO FAT memakai smoothed determinate progress dari koneksi, discovery, binding dan acquisition readiness yang nyata, bukan infinite animation.
Wrapper display Application yang dikenal dinormalisasi saat live signal matching, sedangkan exact source dan event-log reference tetap dipertahankan untuk report dan diagnostic.
Row evidence completed dikecualikan sebelum preflight, live preparation dan session start sehingga row pending dapat dilanjutkan tanpa menghapus atau meminta ulang evidence completed.
Lifecycle guard window mencegah Engineering ditampilkan kembali saat aplikasi shutdown tetapi tetap mempertahankan hide/show instan pada perpindahan workspace normal.
Report FAT memakai hierarchy document-style yang lebih tenang, document control netral, device result inline, title lebih kecil dan modern font fallback stack.
Release gate mencakup full application build, regression IO FAT, deterministic SV evidence test, portable packaging, installer smoke test, checksum, SPDX SBOM dan provenance.
knownLimitations: Windows x64 is the only packaged desktop platform in the current stable release.
The public binaries are not Authenticode code-signed; Windows SmartScreen may show an unrecognized-publisher warning.
Raw-Ethernet GOOSE and Sampled Values workflows require Npcap, an approved capture adapter, suitable permissions and visibility of the relevant multicast traffic.
The MMS route to an IED may not identify a separate process-bus NIC; ARSAS keeps manual adapter selection as the safe fallback when automatic mapping is not unique.
Automatic IO List transition testing currently focuses on approved SDI points; SAI analog tolerance and authorized SDO command campaigns are not silently treated as equivalent tests.
Raw SMV lanes are not calibrated current or voltage measurements until trusted SCL mapping, scaling, synchronization and independent verification are available.
ARSAS is an engineering evidence tool and does not provide IEC 61850 conformance certification or replace calibrated protection testing and approved FAT procedures.
knownLimitationsId: Windows x64 adalah satu-satunya platform desktop yang dipaketkan pada stable release saat ini.
Binary publik belum ditandatangani dengan Authenticode; Windows SmartScreen dapat menampilkan peringatan unrecognized publisher.
Workflow raw-Ethernet GOOSE dan Sampled Values memerlukan Npcap, capture adapter yang disetujui, permission yang sesuai dan visibility traffic multicast terkait.
Route MMS menuju IED belum tentu menunjukkan process-bus NIC yang terpisah; ARSAS mempertahankan pemilihan adapter manual sebagai fallback aman ketika automatic mapping tidak unik.
Automatic transition testing IO List saat ini berfokus pada point SDI yang disetujui; analog tolerance SAI dan authorized SDO command campaign tidak diam-diam dianggap sebagai test yang setara.
Raw lane SMV bukan calibrated current atau voltage measurement sampai trusted SCL mapping, scaling, synchronization dan independent verification tersedia.
ARSAS adalah tool engineering evidence dan tidak memberikan sertifikasi conformance IEC 61850 atau menggantikan calibrated protection testing serta procedure FAT yang disetujui.

codeSigning.label: Not Authenticode-signed
codeSigning.detail: The current public Windows installer and portable binaries do not carry a commercial Authenticode publisher signature. Verify the published SHA-256 value before use. SmartScreen warnings are therefore possible and are not hidden from users.
codeSigning.detailId: Installer Windows dan binary portable publik saat ini belum memiliki commercial Authenticode publisher signature. Verifikasi nilai SHA-256 yang dipublikasikan sebelum digunakan. Karena itu peringatan SmartScreen masih mungkin muncul dan status ini tidak disembunyikan dari user.
